svg.title: Location map St. Petersburg 2
svg.desc: A location map of the region with latitudes between 59.867° and 59.9982°, and longitudes between 30.2156° and 30.4597°. Equirectangular projection, scale 1 : 140 746. The data for this map come from the OpenStreetMap contributors, and are made available by OpenStreetMap under the Open Database License. It was accessed on 2025 Dec 28. The map itself was generated by a Python script written by Justin Kunimune.
